title: Kallu Urf Genderpal v. State of U.P. and others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Neeraj Tiwari, J.; Garima Prashad, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; petitioner relegated to Clause 6.5 before the Executive Engineer.
headnote: Writ challenging an electricity-department notice dismissed for the alternative statutory remedy under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Petitioner may approach the Executive Engineer; any such application to be decided in accordance with law within four weeks of filing.
facts: The petitioner, Kallu Urf Genderpal, invoked Article 226 of the Constitution before the Allahabad High Court challenging a notice dated 18 April 2022 issued by the Electricity Department. At the hearing, counsel for respondent Nos. 2 and 3 submitted that Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 afforded an alternative statutory remedy before the Executive Engineer. The Court did not inquire into the contents or legality of the notice.

holding_units.topic: alternative statutory remedy before Executive Engineer
holding_units.holding: A writ petition challenging an electricity-department notice is dismissed where Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 provides an alternative statutory remedy. The petitioner may approach the Executive Engineer under that clause; any such application shall be decided in accordance with law within four weeks of filing along with a certified copy of the order.

not_decided.point: Legality of the notice dated 18.4.2022 issued by the Electricity Department
